text:
Elena (product): Heads-up: sharing a concise proposal for a 'Lighthouse' onboarding flow for Dedicated customers + conservative capacity thresholds. Wanted feedback from eng/sre before we lock launch criteria.

Samir (eng-product): SGTM to review. Key things I care about: SLA-backed headroom, burst backfill behavior, and how we signal quota exhaustion.

Jo (eng-sre): Please include the emergency fallback policy and an oncall playbook snippet. We should avoid opaque throttles.

Priya (customer-succ): From customers we've heard: need predictable burst windows for marketing spikes, clearer billing signals, and a simple handshake for changing thresholds.

Elena (product): Agreed. Draft summary below (TL;DR then minimal config). Will propose this for the pilot with 3 Lighthouse customers (tiered commit).

Elena (product): TL;DR: 1) Offer a "Lighthouse" onboarding path with 3 phased commit bands (Pilot / Stabilize / Scale). 2) Default conservative thresholds with optional negotiated burst band. 3) Automatic controlled backfill for unused reserved capacity but only within the same account family. 4) Rollout gating: must pass perf and billing pump tests.

Samir (eng-product): Can you put the threshold semantics in config form? Small snippet would help adoption.

Elena (product): Sure — example config for a Lighthouse tenant below:

```yaml
tenant_id: lighthouse-acme
phase: pilot
reserved_pool: 8-gpu
commit_band: pilot
guaranteed_rps: 120
burst_window_minutes: 15
burst_band_quota: 40  # percent of committed capacity
backfill_policy: "intra-account-soft"  # only same-account groups can borrow
preempt_priority: 900
sla_latency_p50_ms: 120
sla_latency_p95_ms: 400
alerts:
  - cpu_util > 85% for 5m
  - queue_len > 100 for 2m
```

Jo (eng-sre): A few quick asks: (1) make burst_window configurable per tenant (ok), (2) record a per-tenant burst-metering export for billing (must), (3) add explicit preempt rules so we can trace evictions.

Elena (product): All doable. My suggested defaults for pilot: burst_window_minutes=15, burst_band_quota=40, and backfill only allowed for same billing org. We can relax in Stabilize.

Priya (customer-succ): For the handshake we need a small checklist customers sign off on before we flip them into Scale:
- traffic profile sample (7 days)
- agreed burst windows and billing impact doc
- contact for emergency + SRE runbook ack

Elena (product): Yes — launching the pilot requires the following gating criteria:
- Perf: < p95 latency SLO regressions vs baseline (<= +10%)
- Observability: per-tenant tokenized cost and burst telemetry in Console (30d retention for pilot)
- Billing: committed-capacity invoice preview generated and acknowledged
- SRE: runbook added to oncall playbook repo with clear preempt thresholds

Jo (eng-sre): Add a runbook snippet I'm pasting here — minimal for pilot:

```text
SRE Runbook - Lighthouse Pilot
1) If tenant latency > SLA p95 for 3 consecutive 5m windows, check reserved pool occupancy.
2) If occupancy > 90% and backfill_active == true, evaluate borrower list and evict soft-borrowers with preempt_priority < 1000.
3) If eviction would impact multiple orgs escalate to oncall lead and toggle emergency-softspill=false.
4) Communicate via #incidents and tag the tenant PM + CSM.
```

Samir (eng-product): On billing signals: we need a lightweight UI flag that indicates "burst consumed X% of month" and an export with line items for committed vs burst tokens. Priya can you validate that's sufficient for customers?

Priya (customer-succ): Yup, that's fine. Also request a one-pager that maps burst usage to expected invoice delta for common scenarios (+10%/ +50% bursts).

Elena (product): Will author the one-pager. Next: fallback and graceful degradation policy — proposal: if pool pressure > 95% for 10m, route new requests to compatible model variant (quantized/cheaper) and flag customer for rate-limit escalations. That keeps service available.

Jo (eng-sre): +1. We need observability traces for route-fallback events so we can correlate to customer impact. Also add a feature flag to disable auto-fallback per tenant for compliance customers.

Elena (product): Good call. I'll add feature-flag and compliance opt-out. Also adding canary rollout steps for the pilot: enable for 1 lighthouse customer for 48h, review perf and billing, then expand to remaining two.

DeployBot: CI pipeline: #deploys/infra  — lighthouse-pilot-config validated, change 8432 passed tests — https://ci.redwood/8432

Samir (eng-product): Final ask: include a soft-commit escape hatch: customers can reduce committed GPU count within the Stabilize band once after negotiation, but cannot increase without 7d notice. Prevents sudden capacity thrash.

Elena (product): Noted. I'll update the spec and circulate a short signoff doc to the SRE and CSM teams. Target: get signoffs by next Wed.

Priya (customer-succ): I'll prep the templates for the handshake and the billing preview.

Jo (eng-sre): I'll write the runbook PR against infra/runbooks and the observability dashboard template.

Elena (product): Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll open the RFC PR and attach the config snippet + gating checklist. :rocket:
